issues.where: the concentric blue-grey rings across the center of the water (also visible in set-C-02.png, set-C-03.png, set-C-04.png, set-C-05.png, and set-C-06.png)
issues.what: perfectly geometric, hard-edged, flat-colored 2D rings that look like a vector target graphic rather than natural waves, ripples, or mineral formations
issues.fix: replace the flat geometric bands with organically broken, physically shaded water ripples or natural depth and mineral variation

issues.where: the dark navy and orange-brown fluid filling the crater (also in set-C-01.png, set-C-02.png, and set-C-03.png)
issues.what: the fluid reads as a matte, airbrushed color gradient with no surface ripples, no depth, no sky reflections, and no specular highlights
issues.fix: add a physically reflective water surface with fine wave detail, sky reflection, depth-based absorption, and grounded lighting interaction

issues.where: the shoreline where the orange-brown fluid meets the rock in the top-left, bottom-left, and bottom-right crops (also in set-C-02.png and set-C-06.png)
issues.what: a hard, jagged, stair-stepped clipping seam with thin bright stepped fringes and no foam, mineral crust, or wet edge on the land
issues.fix: remove the intersection stair-stepping and add a darkened wet rock band, shoreline foam, and natural shallow translucent or crusted edges

issues.where: the rocky terrain slopes in the top-left, bottom-left, and bottom-right crops (also in set-C-04.png and set-C-06.png)
issues.what: the rock looks like soft, blurry molded clay in a single uniform material with visible parallel contour-stepping and banding artifacts across the slopes
issues.fix: eliminate the heightfield stepping artifacts and add crisp rock micro-detail, fractures, scree, and varied mineral and soil materials

issues.where: the small white cloud wisps over the dark water in the left crop (also in set-C-01.png, set-C-02.png, set-C-04.png, and set-C-06.png)
issues.what: the vapour reads as flat, blurry 2D noise patches with no volume, no directional lighting, and no shadows cast onto the surface below
issues.fix: render the wisps as lit volumetric clouds with directional sunlight, internal scattering, and soft shadows projected onto the water

issues.where: the overall aerial view across the crater rim and basin
issues.what: there is no atmospheric haze or sky-driven ambient lighting across the distance, making the scene feel like an airless miniature
issues.fix: add subtle distance-based aerial perspective and consistent sky lighting across both terrain and water
